description: Manage Projects inside a Workspace (Workspace → Project → To-do). Use list with a workspace_id to see its projects, create to add one, update/set_status to change it, progress to get the to-do rollup (total/open/in_progress/blocked/done/waiting_on_reply/percent). portal_status is the client-facing stage (requested, scoped, in_progress, in_review, feedback, complete, on_hold, declined) and mirrors what the client sees in the Astra AI portal; set_status changes only that. delete removes the project. Reach for mind_todos to add or work the to-dos in a project; mind_life still works for the older Focus/Outcome hierarchy.

action.description: list (needs workspace_id) / get / create / update / delete a project, progress (to-do rollup), set_status (change portal_status)

progress.description: Override progress percent (0-100); omit to compute from done to-dos / total

status.description: LIFE status (action, someday, waiting, completed) — on list it filters

tags.description: Free-form tags; on update REPLACES the list

workspace_id.description: Workspace id — required for list and create

name: mind_projects
